meta.name: derisk-measurement-advisor
meta.description: Identify what to measure, test, or track to de-risk a product or AI idea. Use when stress-testing an idea across internal (DUFV) and external (PESTEL) dimensions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 确定要测量与跟踪的指标,让产品想法风险可控
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在验证新产品或 AI 想法的可行性
copy.tagline_en: Decide what to measure to reduce risk of your product idea
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're validating a new product or AI idea

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成风险评估向导:问你产品想法、阶段和客户,再按内部(需求、易用、可行、商业)和外部(PESTEL)10个维度检查,找出该测什么。风险分为「立即行动」和「持续跟踪」,最后给出优先清单和下一步。
howto.when: 当你想检验产品或 AI 想法是否值得投入,或在上路线图前做风险检查时触发。例如给出想法说“帮我评估”,或要求“列出要跟踪的风险”。

say.text: 帮我评估这个 AI 想法:自动写保险理赔回复的智能体,原型阶段。
say.note: Claude 会开始 10 维风险扫描。

say.text: 我们准备把这个产品加入路线图,先做个风险检查。
say.note: 它会按内部和外部维度逐项提问。

say.text: 这个想法值得投入吗?应该先测什么?
say.note: 风险会被标成「立即行动」或「持续跟踪」。

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude becomes a risk advisor: asks idea, stage, customer; scans 10 dimensions (4 internal + 6 external); triages each risk into 'act now' or 'track'; outputs a prioritized risk register.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to stress-test a product or AI idea before committing, or before putting it on the roadmap. It asks for the idea in a sentence or two, then runs the 10-dimensional scan.

say_en.text: Evaluate this AI idea: an agent auto-drafting claim replies, prototype.
We're about to roadmap this product. Run a risk check.
say_en.note: It walks through internal and external dimensions.

say_en.text: Is this idea worth the squeeze? What should we test first?
say_en.note: Risks get tagged act-now or track.
